messages.subject: matching residuals
parts:
Hi.

In reference to my previous post about residual standard error, I'm
having trouble getting the residuals to match. I know Ken had a plot
that compares the residuals from affyPLM and aroma.affymetrix for
some mouse chips ... I'm having trouble recreating that. I'm hoping
its just something I've done incorrectly to match them up. Ken, if
you are reading this and have any

Here is what I've done.


# 'standard' aroma.affymetrix fitting
library(aroma.affymetrix)
verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-8); timestampOn(verbose)
name <- "heart_brain"
chip1<- "HG-U133_Plus_2"
cs1 <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(name, chipType=chip1)
bc1 <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs1)
csBC1 <- process(bc1)
qn1 <- QuantileNormalization(csBC1, typesToUpdate="pm")
csN1 <- process(qn1, verbose=verbose) #time required
plm1.merge <- RmaPlm(csN1)
fit(plm1.merge, verbose=verbose) #time required
chp1.merge<-getChipEffectSet(plm1.merge)
d1<-getExprs(chp1.merge)

# 'standard' affyPLM fitting
fn.u133 <- getPathnames(cs1)
raw<-ReadAffy(filenames=fn.u133,celfile.path=".")
plm<-fitPLM(raw,verbos=9)
d<-coefs(plm)
se.plm<-se(plm)

# the coefficients match very well. SEs match pretty well.
m<-match(rownames(d),rownames(d1))
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(d[,1],d[m,1])
plot(se.plm[,1],s[m,1],log="xy")

# create lookup, get residuals and weights
u133.lu<-createCellLookup(cs1)

ind<-u133.lu$gene=="1007_s_at"

.... some supplementary functions below.


createCellLookup<-function(cs,exon=F) {
ci<-unlist(getCellIndices(getCdf(cs),stratifyBy=c("pm")))
v<-names(ci); names(ci)<-NULL
if (exon)
v<-sub(".indices[0-9]","",v)
else
v<-sub(".indices",".",v)
v<-unlist(strsplit(v,".groups."))
lu<-data.frame(gene=v[seq(1,length(v),by=2)],probe=v[seq(2,length
(v),by=2)],ci)
lu
}

getExprs <- function(ces, ...) {
cdf <- getCdf(ces);
theta <- extractMatrix(ces, ..., returnUgcMap=TRUE);
ugcMap <- attr(theta, "unitGroupCellMap");
rownames(theta) <- getUnitNames(cdf, ugcMap[,"unit"]);
log2(theta)
}
